title: Scored-path A/B: does CARNOT_ARC_STRUCTURED_NAV=1 improve the real E3AgentPolicy cascade on a navigation game (tu93)? Submission-gate evidence.
methodology_note: Same whole-loop scored cascade (run_bounded_progress -> E3AgentPolicy) as the Kaggle submission, same proposer/seed/budget; the ONLY change is CARNOT_ARC_STRUCTURED_NAV. tu93 = clean nav (decisive); ls20 = morph-win negative control (nav inducer should not help). Public-game frames for offline dev.
gate_evidence: structured nav improves the scored cascade on the clean nav game
headline: POSITIVE gate evidence: on the REAL scored E3AgentPolicy cascade, CARNOT_ARC_STRUCTURED_NAV=1 takes tu93 (clean nav game) from L0 (LLM-induction baseline, 0 plans) to L1 (structured nav inducer, 1 plan) -- a real +1-level improvement -- with a CLEAN negative control (ls20, a morph-win non-nav game: no change, so the inducer does not spuriously fire/help). The prior null was a GATE bug (the >=0.5 full-grid exact-match heldout rejected the correct avatar-only nav model before planning); fixed to gate on nav-fit + plan-found.
submission_assessment: PROMISING but NOT yet a submit-decision. (1) The improvement is real and on the SCORED cascade, but it is NARROW: +1 level on ONE PUBLIC nav game; the submission scores on HIDDEN games whose mechanics are unknown (nav-family or not). (2) The negative control shows it does NOT hurt non-nav games, and it is opt-in + non-breaking -> LOW RISK to include. (3) The gate discipline (arc3-online-gated-on-offline-beating-baselines) requires beating the best PRIOR SUBMITTED run; a single public game does not establish that on the hidden set. BEFORE submitting: run a BROADER offline A/B (a representative nav+non-nav subset, flag on vs off) to confirm net aggregate improvement (or gains-on-nav + no-harm), THEN the operator decides. tu93 reaches L1 not L3 here -- the non-idempotent reset still limits deep live solving (REQ-ARC-WMTE-5840), so this is a modest, honest gain, not a step-change.
